scientific_integrity: Proof and standalone exact graph-automorphism and Frobenius-orbit reproducer supplied; finite checks are not treated as proofs of the infinite-field descent theorem; no independent audit or external certification performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the abstract thirty-component Cremona–Richmond stable graph curve over finite fields, not embedded configurations, other genus-sixteen curves, or arbitrary base fields. Mathematical priority is provisional against unexamined historical classifications. Finite group computations are exact, and the extension to all finite fields rests on the separately supplied descent and normalization argument.
title: Thirteen arithmetic forms and eleven zeta spectra of the Cremona–Richmond stable curve
